rules.name: Every task needs acceptance criteria
rules.prd_checker: App. Parameter: minimum count, default 1, not counting the review.
rules.prd_when_off: A task can enter Ready with only the review criterion.

rules.name: Every task needs specific details
rules.instruction: A task has specific details when someone who has never seen it could do it, and a reviewer could tell done from not done, from its goal, its details and its acceptance criteria alone. Pass it when all three hold: the goal says what is to be made or changed, and where; the goal or the details say who or what it is for, or what it must include or avoid; and at least one acceptance criterion names something that can be seen or checked. Fail it when the goal could mean several different pieces of work, when it only says that something should be better, fixed or updated without saying what, or when no criterion can be checked. Do not fail a task for being short, for its style, or for leaving out what its criteria do not need. Do not judge whether the task is worth doing.

rules.name: Workers ask the orchestrator before they ask you
rules.prd_checker: App routes the question. The orchestrator answers from the record, decides, or passes it on. The time and tokens of its answer count as this rule's.
rules.prd_when_off: Every question opens a Needs you item.

rules.name: A different provider reviews every task
rules.prd_checker: App. It refuses a reviewer whose provider has built the task. It ships on.
rules.prd_when_off: Any reviewer seat that never held the task may review.

rules.name: Repeated failed reviews move a task to a stronger model
rules.prd_when_off: Rework returns to the same builder.

rules.name: Projects pause when they reach their budget
rules.prd_when_off: Spending continues past the budget, and the budget stops being part of claim eligibility.

rules.name: The orchestrator approves outward actions itself
rules.prd_checker: Model, the orchestrator. It approves, stops, or passes to the owner. Every approval is listed under Decided for you.
rules.prd_when_off: Every outward action waits for the owner.
